definitions.name: Druid
definitions.summary: Nature's spellcaster who can take the shape of beasts.

definitions.name: Circle of the Moon
definitions.summary: Shapechanging druid who fights in powerful beast and elemental forms.

definitions.name: Combat Wild Shape
definitions.summary: Wild Shape takes a bonus action. While transformed, a bonus action and a spell slot heal you 1d8 per slot level.

actions.name: Combat Wild Shape: heal
actions.note: While in a Wild Shape form: spend a spell slot to regain 1d8 hit points per level of the slot.

definitions.name: Circle Forms
definitions.summary: Wild Shape into beasts of CR 1 from 2nd level; from 6th level, up to your druid level divided by 3 (rounded down). Flying and swimming limits still apply.

definitions.name: Primal Strike
definitions.summary: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.

definitions.name: Elemental Wild Shape
definitions.summary: Spend two Wild Shape uses at once to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

definitions.name: Thousand Forms
definitions.summary: Cast Alter Self at will.

definitions.name: Circle of Dreams
definitions.summary: Fey-touched druid who heals with summer light, guards camps and steps through hidden paths.

definitions.name: Balm of the Summer Court
definitions.summary: A pool of d6s equal to your druid level, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: spend up to half your druid level in dice on a creature within 120 ft; it regains the total rolled plus 1 temporary hit point per die.

actions.name: Balm of the Summer Court
actions.note: Creature within 120 ft: roll the spent d6s and heal that much, plus 1 temp HP per die. Max dice: half your druid level.

definitions.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
definitions.summary: During a short or long rest, ward a 30-ft sphere: you and allies in it get +5 to Stealth and Perception checks, and its light is hidden from outside.

definitions.name: Hidden Paths
definitions.summary: Bonus action: teleport up to 60 ft to a space you can see; or action: teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 ft. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: Hidden Paths
actions.note: Teleport yourself up to 60 ft (bonus action), or a touched willing creature 30 ft (action).

definitions.name: Walker in Dreams
definitions.summary: After a short rest, cast Dream, Scrying or Teleportation Circle (to the last place you took a long rest) without a slot or material components. Once per long rest.

spells.name: Dream
spells.casting: once per long rest, after a short rest, without a slot

spells.name: Scrying
spells.casting: once per long rest, after a short rest, without a slot

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.casting: once per long rest, after a short rest, without a slot

definitions.name: Circle of the Shepherd
definitions.summary: Druid of beasts and fey spirits who empowers allies with a spirit totem and bolsters summons.

definitions.name: Speech of the Woods
definitions.summary: You learn Sylvan, and beasts can understand your speech while you can decipher theirs.

definitions.name: Spirit Totem
definitions.summary: Bonus action: summon a bear, hawk or unicorn spirit within 60 ft for 1 minute, with a 30-ft aura. Bear: temp HP 5 + druid level to chosen creatures and advantage on Strength checks and saves. Hawk: reaction to give advantage on an attack against a target in the aura, plus advantage on Perception. Unicorn: advantage on checks to detect creatures; your slot healing spells also heal everyone in the aura by your druid level. Once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Spirit Totem
actions.note: Summon a spirit within 60 ft for 1 minute (30-ft aura). Bonus action: move it 60 ft.

actions.name: Hawk Spirit
actions.note: A creature attacks a target inside the hawk aura: give it advantage.

definitions.name: Mighty Summoner
definitions.summary: Beasts and fey you summon or create with a spell get 2 extra hit points per Hit Die, and their natural weapons count as magical.

definitions.name: Guardian Spirit
definitions.summary: Beasts and fey you summoned that end their turn in your Spirit Totem aura regain hit points equal to half your druid level.

actions.name: Spirit Totem
actions.note: Summon a spirit within 60 ft for 1 minute (30-ft aura). Bonus action: move it 60 ft.

definitions.name: Faithful Summons
definitions.summary: When you drop to 0 hit points or are incapacitated against your will, you can immediately get the effect of Conjure Animals at 9th level: four protective beasts of CR 2 or lower for 1 hour. Once per long rest.

actions.name: Faithful Summons
actions.note: On dropping to 0 HP or being incapacitated: four CR 2 beasts appear to protect you for 1 hour (no concentration).

definitions.name: Circle of Spores
definitions.summary: Fungal druid who wraps itself in necrotic spores and raises the fallen as zombie servants.

definitions.name: Circle Spells
definitions.summary: You know the Chill Touch cantrip, and gain always-prepared circle spells at 3rd, 5th, 7th and 9th level.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Blindness/Deafness, Gentle Repose.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Animate Dead, Gaseous Form.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Blight, Confusion.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Cloudkill, Contagion.

definitions.name: Halo of Spores
definitions.summary: Reaction when a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 ft of you or starts its turn there: it makes a Constitution save or takes necrotic damage (1d4, rising to 1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 14th).

actions.name: Halo of Spores
actions.note: Creature within 10 ft: Con save or necrotic damage. Doubled dice while Symbiotic Entity is active.

definitions.name: Symbiotic Entity
definitions.summary: Action: spend a Wild Shape use to gain 4 temporary hit points per druid level for 10 minutes (ends early when they run out). Meanwhile Halo of Spores rolls its die twice, and your melee weapon hits deal an extra 1d6 necrotic.

actions.name: Symbiotic Entity
actions.note: 4 temp HP per druid level for 10 minutes; Halo dice doubled; +1d6 necrotic on melee weapon hits.

definitions.name: Fungal Infestation
definitions.summary: Reaction when a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 ft: animate it as a zombie with 1 hit point that obeys your mental commands for 1 hour. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: Fungal Infestation
actions.note: Raise a fresh Small/Medium beast or humanoid corpse within 10 ft as a 1-HP zombie for 1 hour.

definitions.name: Spreading Spores
definitions.summary: Bonus action while Symbiotic Entity is active: hurl spores to a 10-ft cube within 30 ft for 1 minute. Creatures moving into or starting their turn there take your Halo of Spores damage on a failed Con save; you can't use the Halo reaction meanwhile.

actions.name: Spreading Spores
actions.note: Needs Symbiotic Entity. 10-ft cube within 30 ft for 1 minute; Halo damage there, no Halo reaction meanwhile.

definitions.name: Fungal Body
definitions.summary: You can't be blinded, deafened, frightened or poisoned, and critical hits against you count as normal hits unless you're incapacitated.

definitions.name: Circle of Stars
definitions.summary: Druid who reads the constellations, takes on a starry form and casts omens.

definitions.name: Star Map
definitions.summary: You know Guidance and always have Guiding Bolt prepared, and can cast Guiding Bolt without a slot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.casting: always prepared; free a number of times per long rest

definitions.name: Starry Form
definitions.summary: Bonus action: spend a Wild Shape use to become luminous for 10 minutes in one constellation. Archer: bonus action ranged spell attack (60 ft) for 1d8 + Wis radiant. Chalice: when a slot spell heals someone, you or a creature within 30 ft also heals 1d8 + Wis. Dragon: d20s of 9 or lower count as 10 on Int and Wis checks and Con saves to keep concentration.

actions.name: Starry Form
actions.note: 10 minutes. Archer: luminous arrow now and as a bonus action. Chalice: extra healing. Dragon: minimum 10 on Int/Wis checks and concentration saves.

actions.name: Luminous Arrow (Archer)
actions.note: Ranged spell attack, 60 ft: radiant damage on a hit.

actions.name: Chalice healing
actions.note: After a slot healing spell: you or a creature within 30 ft also heals.

definitions.name: Cosmic Omen
definitions.summary: After a long rest, roll a die: even gives Weal, odd gives Woe until your next long rest. Reaction when a creature within 30 ft makes an attack, check or save: add (Weal) or subtract (Woe) 1d6. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

actions.name: Cosmic Omen
actions.note: Creature within 30 ft: add (Weal) or subtract (Woe) 1d6 from its roll.

definitions.name: Twinkling Constellations
definitions.summary: Starry Form's 1d8s become 2d8s; the Dragon grants a 20-ft flying speed with hover; and you can switch constellation at the start of each of your turns.

actions.name: Change constellation
actions.note: At the start of each of your turns while in Starry Form: switch to another constellation.

definitions.name: Full of Stars
definitions.summary: While in Starry Form you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

definitions.name: Circle of Wildfire
definitions.summary: Druid of renewing flame, bonded to a wildfire spirit that burns foes and helps heal.

definitions.name: Circle Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Burning Hands, Cure Wounds.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Plant Growth, Revivify.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Aura of Life, Fire Shield.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Flame Strike, Mass Cure Wounds.

definitions.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
definitions.summary: Action: spend a Wild Shape use to summon your wildfire spirit within 30 ft for 1 hour; creatures within 10 ft of where it appears make a Dex save or take 2d6 fire damage.

actions.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
actions.note: Spirit appears within 30 ft; creatures within 10 ft of it: Dex save or 2d6 fire.

actions.name: Command Wildfire Spirit
actions.note: The spirit acts (Flame Seed or Fiery Teleportation); otherwise it Dodges.

companions.name: Wildfire Spirit
companions.combatNote: Shares your initiative and acts right after you. It takes the Dodge action unless you spend a bonus action to command it. Lasts 1 hour, until it drops to 0 HP, you summon it again, or you die.

traits.name: Defenses
traits.summary: Immune to fire damage; can't be charmed, frightened, grappled, knocked prone or restrained.

traits.name: Fiery Teleportation
traits.summary: Action: it and willing creatures within 5 ft teleport up to 15 ft; creatures within 5 ft of the spot it left make a Dex save against your spell DC or take 1d6 + your proficiency bonus fire damage.

definitions.name: Enhanced Bond
definitions.summary: While your spirit is summoned, add 1d8 to one damage roll of a fire-damage spell or one healing roll of a spell you cast; such spells can also originate from the spirit.

when.text: wildfire spirit summoned; a spell dealing fire damage (one roll)

definitions.name: Cauterizing Flames
definitions.summary: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 ft of you or your spirit, a spectral flame burns in its space for 1 minute. Reaction when a creature you can see enters it: extinguish it to heal or damage that creature by 2d10 + Wisdom modifier (fire). Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

actions.name: Cauterizing Flames
actions.note: Creature in a spectral flame: it heals or takes fire damage.

definitions.name: Blazing Revival
definitions.summary: Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points with your spirit within 120 ft, it drops to 0 and you regain half your hit point maximum and stand up.

actions.name: Blazing Revival
actions.note: At 0 HP with your spirit within 120 ft: the spirit is destroyed and you regain half your HP maximum.

definitions.name: Additional Druid Spells
definitions.summary: Tasha's adds spells to the druid list (including Infestation, Primal Savagery, Protection from Evil and Good, Augury, Continual Flame, Enlarge/Reduce, Aura of Vitality, Elemental Weapon, Revivify, Divination, Fire Shield and Cone of Cold) for you to prepare.

definitions.name: Wild Companion
definitions.summary: Action: spend a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar without material components. The familiar is a fey and lasts for half your druid level in hours.

actions.name: Wild Companion
actions.note: Cast Find Familiar (fey) without components; it lasts half your druid level in hours.

definitions.name: Cantrip Versatility
definitions.summary: Whenever you gain an Ability Score Improvement, you may swap one druid cantrip you know for another druid cantrip.

definitions.name: Circle of the Heammer
definitions.summary: Methic druids of fire and light who guard the land from the Nighton, the bitter frost and darkness.
text: Dedicated to protecting the land from the Nighton and the bitter frost, the Druids of this Circle weave the magic of fire and light in a way unmatched by others. Their powers and abilities follow the Shamanic Trails, and they are often known as Methic Druids.

A Methic Druid will never allow the otherworldly cold to prevail, a disease to spread, or darkness to seep into the world. The Eternal Metheus is reflected deep within their eyes, and the gentle warmth of hope and salvation lives in their touch.

In a clearing where night never falls, deep within an ancient forest, or atop a solitary peak that always shines, one might find a Druid of the Heammer gazing toward the heavens, their hair dancing mysteriously in the colors of flame.

definitions.name: Circle Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells, and druid spells for you: Burning Hands, Guiding Bolt.
text: You have become an instrument of hope and salvation, a beacon capable of protecting the land from dark annihilation. Your connection to Methic light and flame grants you access to certain spells when you reach specific Druid levels, as shown in the Circle of the Heammer Spells table.

Once you gain access to one of these spells, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the Druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a Druid spell for you.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells, and druid spells for you: Flaming Sphere, Lesser Restoration.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells, and druid spells for you: Daylight, Plant Growth.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells, and druid spells for you: Fire Shield, Guardian of Faith.

definitions.name: Circle Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells, and druid spells for you: Flame Strike, Greater Restoration.

definitions.name: Floar
definitions.summary: Bonus action, one Wild Shape use: 10 minutes of Methic flame. Resistance to fire and radiant; your spells' fire and radiant damage +1d10 and swappable between the two; hostile creatures near you take your proficiency bonus in fire or radiant damage; Fire Bolt as a druid spell.
text: You have learned to rekindle the Methic Flame within yourself. As a bonus action on your turn, you can expend one use of your Wild Shape. Your body then undergoes temporary changes that reflect this transformation. You decide what these changes look like. For example, your eyes might begin to glow, or your hair might become incandescent and start waving like a flame.

These changes last for 10 minutes, until you change form (such as by using your Wild Shape feature or the Polymorph spell), until you choose to end them (no action required), until you become incapacitated, until you use this feature again, or until you die.
While these changes are active, you gain the following benefits:
- You have resistance to fire and radiant damage.

- Whenever you deal damage with a spell, you can change fire damage to radiant damage, or radiant damage to fire damage. For example, you can change the damage type of Burning Hands to radiant damage.
- The fire and radiant damage you deal with spells increases by 1d10.

- Hostile creatures that start their turn within 10 feet of you, or enter that area for the first time on a turn, take fire or radiant damage (your choice when you activate Floar) equal to your proficiency bonus.
- While Floar is active, you gain access to the Fire Bolt cantrip. You can cast it as a Druid spell.

actions.name: Floar
actions.note: 10 minutes: resistance to fire and radiant, +1d10 to your spells' fire and radiant damage (swap one for the other on the roll), an aura of {pb} damage, and Fire Bolt. It ends if you change form, become incapacitated, use it again, or end it.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.casting: while Floar is on, as a druid spell

definitions.name: Untamed Flame
definitions.summary: A Circle spell with a casting time of 1 action can be cast as a bonus action, if its level and the slot's are no greater than your proficiency bonus. Then roll a d10: on a 10, the slot isn't spent.
text: You now draw your magic from Metheus, weaving your spells in a way that allows no compromise. As a bonus action on your turn, you can cast a Circle spell that has a casting time of 1 action, provided the spell's level is no greater than your proficiency bonus. The spell slot you expend must also be of a level no greater than your proficiency bonus.
Additionally, when you cast a Circle spell in this way, you can roll a d10. If the result is 10, the spell slot you expended isn't consumed.

definitions.name: Theros
definitions.summary: Once per long rest, casting Plant Growth over 8 hours, invoke a phenomenon for 1d10 days or until the next full moon: Fair Weather, Heammer Wisps (half your druid level of them), Thawing Cold (cold damage in the area −1d10, at least 1) or Radiant Passage (bonus action: teleport within half a mile into bright light you've seen).
text: Your existence is now intertwined with the Heammer, fair weather, and the fertility of the land. Once per long rest, when you cast Plant Growth using its 8-hour casting time, you can also invoke one of the following phenomena. The chosen phenomenon lasts for 1d10 days or until the next full moon, whichever comes first.

- Fair Weather. The weather within the spell's one-mile area becomes clear, with sunshine during the day or a starry sky at night, and the temperature becomes mild to warm. This phenomenon cannot override other magical effects.

- Heammer Wisps. You can summon a number of Heammer Wisps equal to half your Druid level in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of you. These creatures obey your verbal commands, but disappear if they leave the spell's one-mile area.
- Thawing Cold. Cold damage from spells and other phenomena, both magical and nonmagical, within the spell's one-mile area is reduced by 1d10, to a minimum of 1.

- Radiant Passage. As a bonus action, you can teleport to any unoccupied space within half a mile of the spell's area. You must have seen the destination at least once before, and it must be within an area of bright light.

actions.name: Theros
actions.note: When your Plant Growth cast over 8 hours ends: invoke one phenomenon for 1d10 days (roll it) or until the next full moon. Heammer Wisps: half your druid level of them.

castReminder.text: you can invoke a phenomenon now (Actions → Theros), once per long rest.

definitions.name: Zenith
definitions.summary: Floar sheds sunlight (bright 5 ft, dim 5 ft more). While it's on: your leveled spells' fire and radiant damage +1d10 per spell level (in place of Floar's 1d10); advantage on attacks against creatures in your sunlight; a reaction to halve cold or necrotic damage to you or a creature in it; Untamed Flame gives +2 AC until your next turn.
text: Your Floar transformation knows no compromise. When you activate Floar, you emit bright sunlight in a 5-foot radius and dim sunlight for an additional 5 feet. While Floar is active, you also gain the following benefits:
- The fire and radiant damage you deal with spells of 1st level or higher increases by 1d10 for each level of the spell.
- The sunlight you emit becomes an extension of yourself and your senses. You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures within the radius of the sunlight emitted by your Floar.

- When you or a creature within the radius of your Floar's sunlight takes cold or necrotic damage, you can use your reaction to halve that damage for the chosen creature. You must make this decision before the damage is rolled.
- When you use Untamed Flame, your AC increases by 2 until the start of your next turn.

when.text: the target is in your Floar's sunlight (within 10 ft)

actions.name: Zenith: ward against the cold
actions.note: Before cold or necrotic damage is rolled against you or a creature in your sunlight: halve it. On you, enter the damage next; on someone else, they halve it.
